reason: I've never heard of this store and I'd be wiring a fixture into my kitchen in three weeks, so I'm not putting $360 on a site I can't vouch for. I'd maybe save the pendant to a Pinterest board and see if it holds up.
objection: Is this store legit? I can't see anything here that tells me the fixture is what the photo shows, and if I change my mind I eat the return shipping on a bulky box.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews with customer photos of the pendant installed, a safety listing (UL/ETL) shown on the product, and a clear contact and returns page I can check. Free return shipping, or a sample of the shade, would also help.
